messages:
alex: Heads-up — our JS SDK + sample app is failing on Bun (edge runtime). auth token refresh throws `TypeError: crypto.subtle is undefined` and then the retry path just swallows the error.

alex: Repro (very small):
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const r = new Redwood({ apiKey: Deno.env.get('REDWOOD_KEY') });
await r.generate('hello');
```
It works in node and Deno but Bun edge sandbox blows up during auth. stack: `at getKey (auth.ts:42)` -> `crypto.subtle.importKey` missing.

jin: ugh, Bun's webcrypto is weird. does bun run --experimental-fetch? also are you bundling to ESM? Bun can flip on different globals depending on entrypoint.

alex: bundle is ESM. We ship SDK as dual CJS/ESM and the edge bundle picks ESM. On Bun it sometimes resolves the CJS entry which causes a require() -> SyntaxError for exported constants.

maria: two separate problems: (1) webcrypto polyfill missing / inconsistent, (2) resolver picking wrong entrypoint for our package.json exports. We saw similar in the sample-app CI.

sam: can you try a quick monkeypatch to confirm? `globalThis.crypto = require('node:crypto').webcrypto` for node, but bun can't require node:crypto. For Bun try `globalThis.crypto = await import('node:crypto').then(m=>m.webcrypto)` — might not work either.

alex: tried polyfill libs (isomorphic-webcrypto, @peculiar/webcrypto) but then fetch behavior diverges and retries break (they depend on URLSearchParams shim). :facepalm:

jin: For the resolver issue we should ensure our package.json exports include an explicit "browser"/"bun" path or at least explicit "import" and "require" fields so Bun's resolver doesn't fallback incorrectly.

maria: agree. Also add runtime detection in SDK: if (!globalThis.crypto?.subtle) try to detect Bun/Deno edge and use native fallback patterns or a light-weight WASM subtle shim. Add a gated opt-in so we don't bloat hosted paths.

sam: quick triage plan: 1) add failing e2e test in sample-app CI for bun runtime, 2) open GH issue with minimal repro and stack, 3) patch exports in package.json to be unambiguous, 4) add doc note for onboarding (bun users).

alex: created a minimal repro gists link: https://gist.github.com/alex/abcdef (contains import map + steps). CI failing run: `dev-bot: test/bun-edge` shows 1 failing.

dev-bot: test-runner: bun-edge/smoke — failed (auth-webcrypto.ts) — job 4572.

jin: I'll take the exports + package.json change. Maria can you prototype a tiny conditional shim inside auth module to avoid calling subtle directly? We can gate by process?.versions?.bun or globalThis.Bun.

maria: yep. I'll also try bundling an ESM-only dist to point edge runtimes at. Might be simplest.

sam: we should also add a short paragraph in onboarding docs: "If you're running in Bun/Deno edge, prefer the ESM edge bundle and ensure webcrypto is available; see troubleshooting." saves users hitting this.

alex: cool — leaving notes in the sample-app issue. tagging @devex to update quickstart.

alex: final note: this thread reproduced three DX friction points — auth/webcrypto, resolver/exports, and retry semantics when underlying crypto fails. recommend we add a flaky-e2e matrix for edge runtimes so these regressions get caught early.
